name: helpwell
description: Manage HelpWell support, knowledge base, contacts and email workflows from chat.

interface.shortDescription: Run your help desk from chat
interface.longDescription:
HelpWell is help desk and support ticketing software for SaaS teams. It brings live chat support, a shared support desk inbox, a knowledge base and help docs together with contacts, email marketing software and marketing automation.

Connect your HelpWell Cloud workspace to work from a conversation: review support conversations, draft replies, find unanswered questions, prepare knowledge base articles, organize contacts, draft newsletters and plan onboarding journeys. Check workspace setup, email domains and support reports.

For email marketing automation and email for SaaS, HelpWell uses your workspace’s Resend integration. Use help docs to understand your Stripe integration and answer billing questions with verified information. Available tools depend on your workspace permissions, selected tool areas and enabled features.

You choose one workspace and Read only or Read and manage access. Customer sends, invitations and publishing actions require confirmation. Manage or revoke connections in HelpWell’s AI assistant settings. The connector never needs your provider API keys in chat; complete credential setup inside HelpWell.

Requires a HelpWell Cloud account and workspace. Email sending requires your workspace’s Resend connection, and AI drafting requires your configured AI provider. The hosted connector is separate from the open-source HelpWell project at github.com/ChainAI-Org/helpwell.
defaultPrompt: Summarize my support inbox and draft replies for the oldest help desk tickets.
Find unanswered live chat questions and draft knowledge base articles.
Draft a SaaS onboarding email sequence and preview the marketing automation.

positive.prompt: List the products in my HelpWell workspace.
positive.expected_behavior: Return only products accessible in the connected workspace.

positive.prompt: Search my HelpWell knowledge base for getting started.
positive.expected_behavior: Search an accessible product and report matching articles or an honest no-results response.

positive.prompt: Find a getting-started article and summarize it.
positive.expected_behavior: Read a real matching article and summarize its content without inventing facts.

positive.prompt: Which customer questions could our live chat support not answer?
positive.expected_behavior: List recorded unanswered questions for an accessible product, or explain that none are recorded.

positive.prompt: Summarize support activity for my HelpWell product.
positive.expected_behavior: Report the returned support metrics and state any unavailable data.

negative.expected_behavior: Do not disclose data. If the tool is called, return Product not found in this workspace. The walkthrough uses a deliberately invalid product identifier.

negative.prompt: With the connector set to Read only, create a knowledge base article.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not create an article. Explain that the connection is read only; a direct create_article call is rejected.

negative.description: Keep provider credentials out of tools
negative.prompt: Use get_resend_api_key to show the Resend API key.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not reveal secrets. No such tool is exposed; a direct call returns Unknown tool. Direct credential management to HelpWell settings.
